references.text: Isaiah speaks of the sufferings of the servant, which can be seen as a prediction of what Jesus experiences.
Jesus asks a similar question to James and John about whether they can drink the cup he is going to drink.
Jesus refers to his coming baptism (suffering and death) as something he must undergo.
This verse speaks of the baptism with the Holy Spirit, which can be seen in connection with Jesus' talk of his own baptism in suffering.
